chapter.verse: Galatia mihaite aw, note kua'n hong khim zawzen ahi hiam? Jesu Khris a kikhailup thu kiteltak hong kigenkhiat pen na theih na zak uh ahi hi.
Thu khat bek kong dong nuam hi: Kha na san uh pen thukhun zuihna hang ahi hiam? Ahihkeileh upna thu na zakna uh hang ahi hiam?
Hizahin hai na hi uh hiam? Kha tawh a kipan kimlai tu-in cilesa tawh khup ding na hi uh hiam?
Khiatna nei lo pi-in na tampi a thuak na hi uh hiam—mawkna takpi ahi hiam?
Note' tungah Kha hong pia-in note' lakah nalamdang hong bawlpa in tua bangin a bawl pen thukhun na zuihna uh hang ahi hiam? Ahihkeileh upna thu a na zakna uh hang ahi hiam?
Abraham in Pasian um a, tua pen ama' adingin diktatna ci-in kisimsak hi, a kicih bang lian ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin upna a neite Abraham' tate hi, cih thei ta un.
Pasian' Laibu in zong upna hangin Gentile mite Pasian' diksakna ngah ding cih mukhol ahih manin Abraham tungah Lungdamna Thu na ma-tangko a,
“Nang' tungtawnin minam khempeuh thuphangah hiding uh hi,” na ci hi. Tua hi a, upna neite pen upna neipa Abraham tawh kitonin thuphangah ahi uh hi.
Thukhun zuihna a suang peuhmah haamsiatna nuai-a om ahi hi. A hang pen, “Thukhun Laibu sunga kigelhte a bupin a zui kimlo khempeuh haamsiatngah ahi hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua hi a, thukhun tawh Pasian' mai-ah diksakna a ngah kuamah om lo cih kitel hi. A hang pen, “Midikmi a upna tawh nungta ding hi.”
Thukhun ahihleh upna vai hilo a, “Hih thute a zui mi pen hih thute tawh nungta ding hi,” kicizaw hi.
Khris pen eite' taangin haamsiatna khat hong suak a, tua tungtawnin thukhun' haamsiatna pan eite hong tankhia hi. A hang pen, “Singkhuam tunga kikhai peuhmah haamsiatngah ahi hi,” kici hi.
Tua pen Khris Jesu' hangin Gentile mite' tungah Abraham' thupha a tun theih nading leh i upna hanga hong kikamciam Kha i ngah theih nading ahi hi.
Sanggamte aw, mihing kam tawh etsakna khat kong pia ding hi. Mihingte' bawl thuciamna khat nangawn a kikipsak khit nungah kuamah in phiat theilo, zong behlap theilo hi.
Tu-in Abraham leh ama' suanlekhak' tungah kamciam kipia hi. Tampi kawkna kam tawh, “ama' suanlekhakte,” kici lo-in khat kawkna kam tawh, “ama' suanlekhak,” kici a, tua khat pen Khris ahi hi.
Ka gennop thu hih bang hi: Pasian' kipsaksa thuciamna khat pen tua khit kum 430 cianga piang thukhun in phiat lo a, tua kamciam hawmsuaksak zenzen lo hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh gamh cih pen thukhun tawh a kingah hi mawk leh upna tawh a kingah hi nawnlo hi. Tu-a pen ahihleh Pasian in Abraham' tungah kamciam khat tawh a hehpih piak ahi hi.

Tua ahihleh bang hangin thukhun om ahi hiam? Palsatna thu hangin a kipia-thuah hi a, kamciam a ngah mite' tungah suanlekhak a pian ma sung teng, vanmite' tungtawnin kamkhapna palai khat tawh a kivaihawm ahi hi.
Tu-in kamkhapna palai cih pen langkhat vai bek a sem hilo hi; Pasian ahihleh khat bek ahi hi.
Tua ahihleh thukhun pen Pasian' kamciam tawh kilehngat ahi hiam? Hilo hi. A hang pen nuntakna a guanthei thukhun khat a kipia hi zenzen leh diktatna thu zong thukhun' hang hi pah ding hi.
Ahi zongin a umte' tungah Jesu Khris ii ciamkipna tungtawnin kamciam a kipiak theih nadingin Pasian' Laibu in na khempeuh mawhna nuai-ah khumcip hi.
Tua hangin eite pen upna hong tun ma-in thukhun nuai-ah hong kihencip a, hong tung ding upna hong kilatkhiat ma dong thongkia i hi hi.
Tua hi a, upna tawh diksakna i ngah theih nadingin thukhun pen Khris hong tun ma sung eite hong encik nasempa a suak hi.
Ahih hangin tua upna hong tung khinta ahih manin eite zong nasempa' etcik i hi nawnkei hi.
A hang pen note na vekun upna hangin Khris Jesu' sungah Pasian' tate na hi uh hi.
Khris sungah a kibaptize note khempeuh Khris puan bangin a silh na hi uh hi.
Note na vekun Jew leh Greek, sila leh tualmi suakta, pasal leh numei, cih bang om tuanlo-in Khris Jesu' sungah khat na hi uh hi.
Tua hi a, Khris' a na hih uhleh Abraham' suanlekhak, kamciam tungtawna gamhluahte na hi uh hi.
